tts.msg_001: Starting today, let's build habits that help your sleep.
tts.msg_002: Set your worries and thoughts aside for a moment.
tts.msg_003: Try focusing on your breathing while in bed.

step1.msg_001: Starting today, let's build habits that help your sleep.
step1.msg_002: How many hours did you sleep yesterday?
step1.msg_003: Please record your sleep time first.
step1.msg_004: How was your sleep quality yesterday?

step2.msg_002: You may be dealing with stress from treatment and worries about the future.
step2.msg_003: When you lie down, those thoughts may rush in even more.
step2.msg_004: But getting lost in those thoughts in bed can interfere with sleep a lot.
step2.msg_005: If thoughts come up when you are trying to sleep, focus on your breathing.
step2.msg_006: Simply paying attention to your breath can reduce unnecessary thoughts and help you fall asleep more easily.
step2.msg_007: If there is an important worry you need to think through, jot it down at a desk 2 to 3 hours before bedtime.

step3.msg_001: Lie down and focus on your breathing
step3.msg_002: When thoughts come up in bed,
step3.msg_003: pay attention to your inhale and exhale.
step3.msg_004: As you focus on your breathing, your thoughts will gradually fade and your mind will feel calmer. Before long, sleep will come naturally.

mission: Lie down and focus on your breathing
previousMission: Sleep and wake up at the planned time
